AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.intro: The Cultural Association of Mikrasians of Limenaria "To Charaki" was founded to preserve the memory, traditions, and identity of the Asia Minor Greek refugees who found a new home in Limenaria, Thasos — and to pass that heritage on to future generations.
AboutPage.journeyIntro: From a small gathering of families determined to keep their heritage alive to a thriving cultural home — follow the milestones that shaped our community.

foundation.title: Foundation of the Association
foundation.description: A group of Mikrasian families in Limenaria come together to found the Association, determined to keep the memory of Asia Minor alive.

firstActivities.title: The First Activities
firstActivities.description: The Association organizes its earliest gatherings, cultural evenings, and community events, laying the foundation for what was to come.

danceGroups.title: Creation of Cultural & Dance Groups
danceGroups.description: Dedicated dance and music groups are formed to teach and preserve the traditional dances and songs of Asia Minor.

culturalEvents.title: Cultural Events & Community Activities
culturalEvents.description: The Association grows into a vibrant community hub, hosting festivals, celebrations, and events that bring generations together.

collaborations.title: Collaborations & Participation in Cultural Events
collaborations.description: The Association partners with other cultural organizations and takes part in regional and national events, sharing its heritage more widely.

today.title: Today
today.description: "To Charaki" continues its mission — preserving memory, celebrating culture, and welcoming new generations into its story.
